en-US.title: NARCØDEX
en-US.subtitle: Harm reduction reference
en-US.promoText: Adult reference for substances, risks, and interactions. Not medical advice and not a dosing tool.
en-US.releaseNotes: First release of the NARCØDEX archive for iPhone.
en-US.description:
NARCØDEX is a plain-spoken reference library of substances, cannabis cultivars, interactions, and history. It is written for adults who want the evidence, the risks, and the harm-reduction context in one place.

This is not a pharmacy, a marketplace, or a dosing tool. The archive does not sell anything, does not tell you where to obtain a substance, and does not give you a dose to take. It tells you what is known, how solid that knowledge is, and what can go wrong.

What you can do
• Search a public archive of substance files, each tagged with an evidence tier
• Read legal status, medical context, risks, dependence, withdrawal, and harm-reduction notes
• Check a two-substance interaction and see when a combination is catalogued as dangerous
• Browse pharmacological classes and a historical timeline
• Look up cannabis cultivars with reported THC and CBD ranges and terpene notes
• Read a field guide to reagent colour tests, including the limits of those tests
• Optionally sign in to save files and keep a private reading history

What this app will not do
• It will not recommend that you use a drug
• It will not calculate a dose
• It will not help you buy, make, or conceal a substance
• A missing interaction is not a sign that a combination is safe

Every screen carries the same rule the archive was built on: this is not medical advice. If someone is in trouble, contact local emergency services.

NARCØDEX is for adults. The first launch asks you to confirm you are 18 or older.
